podcast.body: Costello's biggest ever UK single, reaching number two. The song, however, also drew attention for an "unfortunate use of the N-word." Although it passed cultural gatekeepers at the time, the lyric later seemed even more regrettable in light of his Columbus, Ohio, incident. "Oliver's Army."

podcast.body: The music video for this song was one of the first 40 videos played on MTV on its inaugural day in 1981. However, Costello's videos at the time were generally described as relatively low-tech affairs compared to the slicker, glossier, and more expensive productions that would soon dominate the channel and influence the sound of new wave. "on the video channel's first day, his Oliver's Army was one of the first 40 videos MTV played."
